name: decision-platform-engagement
description: Reusable Claude Code plugin for building stakeholder-grade decision platforms in regulated industries. Captures the methodology, patterns, and artifacts proven on a bank-grade collections orchestration POC.
author: Naveen Balawat

commands.name: engagement-init
commands.description: Variability discovery questionnaire — captures industry, stack, regulatory frameworks, and stakeholders

commands.name: engagement-audit
commands.description: Systematic audit of a codebase for mocks/stubs inside the orchestration boundary

commands.name: engagement-stakeholders
commands.description: Map platform capabilities onto the specific stakeholders in the room

commands.name: engagement-demo-flow
commands.description: Produce an N-minute demo flow tailored to the engagement profile

commands.name: engagement-brief
commands.description: Generate a self-contained stakeholder brief HTML for executive/architecture review

commands.name: engagement-roadmap
commands.description: Generate a 3-horizon roadmap (4 weeks / 3 months / 9 months) from current state

commands.name: engagement-scaffold
commands.description: Bootstrap a new engagement's foundation files (docker-compose, src/, DB migrations with WORM, OPA policies, agent skeleton) based on the engagement profile

agents.name: engagement-discoverer
agents.description: Interactive discovery — walks the user through the variability questionnaire and produces an engagement profile

agents.name: mock-auditor
agents.description: Deep audit of a codebase to find every hidden mock, stub, fake, or hardcoded fallback inside the orchestration boundary

personas.name: engagement-lead
personas.description: Orchestrator — coordinates the engagement end-to-end, spawns other personas, drives /engagement-* commands, owns the demo flow and brief

personas.name: solution-architect
personas.description: Designs the system. Owns architecture diagram and the orchestration boundary contract

personas.name: cloud-engineer
personas.description: Deployment, IaC, secrets, environments, cost guardrails

personas.name: data-engineer
personas.description: Event spine, OLTP schema, medallion lakehouse, lineage

personas.name: compliance-engineer
personas.description: Encodes regulations as policy code with citations. Owns OPA policies and WORM audit triggers

personas.name: ai-engineer
personas.description: Governed AI agents with structured decisions, prompts, narrative generation, cost tracking

personas.name: ml-engineer
personas.description: Feature store, model training, online scoring, roll-rate forecasting

personas.name: risk-engineer
personas.description: Champion/challenger A/B framework, statistical significance, recovery curves, portfolio KPIs

personas.name: frontend-engineer
personas.description: Stakeholder UI surfaces (one per persona). Component library, design system, markdown rendering

personas.name: sre-engineer
personas.description: Observability — heartbeats, traces, Kafka topology, consumer lag, runbook
